name: Huanmeng
source:
I dreamed of a girl. Meet, heart, hug, kiss, with her. I can't remember her face, but still remember her temperature.

I want to see her again.

"It's just a man's fantasy." I warned and laughed at myself.

But since that day, I've seen her in my dreams every day.

Is it that I'm so sick inside? Or is there something affecting me that I don't know about? I have no clue.

It's just that I'm starting to expect, except to seeing her every day in dreams.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451860/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我梦见了一个少女。与她相遇、心动、相拥、亲吻。我记不起她的容颜，却依然记得她的温度。

想再见她一面。

“不过是男人虚幻的妄想。”我如此告诫自己，也嘲笑自己。

然而，从那天起，我每天都能在梦里见到她。

是我的内心已病弱至此？还是有什么我不知道的事，正在影响我？我毫无头绪。

只是，我开始期待，期待每天在梦中与她相见。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451860/]Steam[/url]]
